en.html:
There is Ichijou, as expected. Outside some team's garage, facing a large man who looks like a mechanic. Dirty looks are being exchanged at full capacity.

Behind her, a boy sits where he has landed on his backside.

と対峙し、険悪な形相を交換し合っている。

　そして一条の背後には、尻餅をついた男の子。
